choice_basis: First-choice applicants only. Georgia publishes, per zone, the points that assured a win, the random draw point and how many applicants at that point drew. Applicants at or above the assured-win level are derived as total selected minus random-draw winners; all lower point levels are grouped into one row (nobody there drew).

sources.label: Georgia DNR 2025 Alligator Lottery Odds Report (PDF)

notes: Georgia alligator permits are a priority-point quota hunt: you choose how many points to wager, and only the points needed are deducted when you're selected. Residents and nonresidents draw together. 13,123 first-choice applicants in 2025.
